Short title and extent

The Juvenile Smoking Ordinance
The Juvenile
Smoking Ordinance
(X11 OF 1959)
(This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of W. P. on 21st
March. 1959; published in the W. P. Gazette (Extraordinary), dated 26th March,
1959; pages 205‑207 saved and given perma nent effect by Article 225 of
the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan (1962).)
[26th March, 1959]
An Ordinance to
amend and consolidate the law relating to pre venation of smoking of tobacco by
juveniles in the province of West Pakistan
1. Short title and extent:
(1) This Ordinance may be called the Juvenile Smoking Ordinance; 1959.
(2) It extends to the whole of
the Province of the Punjab except the Tribal Areas,

Definitions

The Juvenile Smoking Ordinance
The Juvenile
Smoking Ordinance
(X11 OF 1959)
(This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of W. P. on 21st
March. 1959; published in the W. P. Gazette (Extraordinary), dated 26th March,
1959; pages 205‑207 saved and given perma nent effect by Article 225 of
the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan (1962).)
[26th March, 1959]
An Ordinance to
amend and consolidate the law relating to pre venation of smoking of tobacco by
juveniles in the province of West Pakistan
2. Definitions: In this
Ordinance, unless the context otherwise requires, the following expressions
shall have the meanings hereby res pectively assigned to them, that is to say-‑
(a) Affiliated college"
means any collegiate institution affiliated to any University, Board of Secondary
Education in the Punjab ;
(b) Government means the
Provincial Government of the Punjab ;
(c) Juvenile" means any
person who is under the age of sixteen years;
(d) Public place" Includes
any public park, garden, railway station, ground or vehicle to which the public
for the time being have access, whether on payment or otherwise ;
(e) recognized school"
means any school recognized by any Uni versity or the Board of Secondary
Education in the Punjab or by the Education Department of Government; and
(f) tobacco" means tobacco
in any form and includes any smoking mixture intended as a substitute for
tobacco.

Penalty for selling tobacco to juvenile

The Juvenile Smoking Ordinance
The Juvenile
Smoking Ordinance
(X11 OF 1959)
(This Ordinance was promulgated by the Governor of W. P. on 21st
March. 1959; published in the W. P. Gazette (Extraordinary), dated 26th March,
1959; pages 205‑207 saved and given perma nent effect by Article 225 of
the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan (1962).)
[26th March, 1959]
An Ordinance to
amend and consolidate the law relating to pre venation of smoking of tobacco by
juveniles in the province of West Pakistan
3. Penalty for selling tobacco
to juvenile: (1)‑ Whoever sells or gives or attempts to sell or give
tobacco to a juvenile whether for his own use or not, shall be punished in the
case of a first offence with fine which may extend to twenty rupees and in the
case of a second offence with fine which may extend to fifty rupees and in the
case of a third or subsequent offence with fine which may extend to one hundred
rupee.
(2) If a person convicted under
the last preceding sub‑section holds a dealer's licence under the Punjab
Tobacco Vend Act. 1958 (West Pakistan XXXVIII of 1958), this conviction under
this section shall be notified by the Magistrate to the District Excise and
Taxation Officer con cerned so as to enable him to cancel the convict's
licence.

4. Seizure of tobacco smoked
by a juvenile in a public place:-- If any juvenile be found smoking tobacco
in any public place, it shall be lawful for any teacher or proctor of a
recognized school or affiliated college or any other person authorized by
Government in this behalf, 't0 seize such tobacco and destroy it.
